images.name: light
images.prompt:
Ultra-wide 3:1 panoramic game background, 2000 x 667, stylized painterly 3D-render look.
Reference 1 furnace room: use its art style, materials and props ONLY (brick, riveted dark iron, copper pipes with brass gauges, caged amber lamps, heavy furnace doors glowing at seams). Reference 2 lab hall: use its exact camera and composition, paired pillars, distant central focus, empty foreground and furnished lateral areas.
Camera: seated viewer eye level, horizon 48% up from bottom, curved cylindrical 270-degree panoramic feel, dominant one-point perspective with vanishing point dead centre. Overhead iron girders, ducts and copper pipes and floor flagstones and grates converge strongly toward centre, gently curving like Kyoto veranda beams and floorboards; no fisheye bulge top or bottom.
Layout: raised riveted iron observation deck overlooking a vast underground mail incinerator hall. Two thick brick-and-iron pillars with caged amber lamps stand left and right of centre like lab posts. Low iron rails with small amber lamps along deck edge, broad gap in middle.
Focus: about 10 metres away, one great central incinerator furnace, perfectly centred, brightest thing. Large in real world but modest distant scale in image, not a closeup. Round riveted furnace mouth OPEN with roaring orange-yellow fire inside, subtle heat shimmer and sparse sparks. Hopper overflowing with cream envelopes above, fed by big chute from ceiling. Mouth just below horizon. Painted hazard square around machine, grated channel leads straight from deck to mouth.
Furnished main hall: to each side set back 5 metres, rows of smaller CLOSED furnaces with orange seams, mail sorting tables and conveyors with envelopes and parcels, canvas mail carts, mail sacks, coal and ember bins, valve wheels and gauges. Far walls more furnace doors, shelves of mail boxes and copper pipework softened by smoke and haze. Centre lane stays clear.
Sides: long brick corridors recede into depth; nearer outer left and right edges workbenches with wrenches red valve wheels gauges and mail cart or recycling bin, like lab's desks and trolleys. Further down more furnaces pipes lamps. Busy detail at lateral edges and midground.
Foreground deck empty worn iron plates and flagstones catching firelight, no bench or props in near centre, open air all the way to furnace. No table spanning foreground.
Lighting warm and working, caged amber lamps on, central furnace strong orange glow across floor and pillars, smaller furnace seams glowing. Light smoke and sparse drifting embers far hall.
No people, no written text or lettering, UI, characters, vignette, weapons. Physical mail envelopes are required, without writing. Single full bleed panorama.

images.name: dark
images.prompt: Use attached image as base so layout is identical. Same camera, composition and every object in exactly the same place. Only lighting changes: caged lamps dimmed to faint amber and hall is dark, lit mostly by fire. Great central furnace mouth blazes brighter orange-yellow, furnace door seams glow hot orange, sparse embers drift through deep plum and charcoal shadows. Orange reflections on floor, smoke darker and moodier in far hall. Preserve all pillars, rails, benches, conveyors, mail carts, sacks, envelopes, chute, pipes, gauges and open central lane exactly. Preserve distant central furnace scale and empty near foreground. Readable side silhouettes in subtle reflected firelight. Same stylized painterly 3D art, ultra-wide 3:1, 2000 x 667. No new objects, people, text, UI, vignette or camera movement.
